about: Element ids a world folder writer refuses and ids it writes: the npm SDK's folder writer (worldFolderFiles, convertKanka) and the Python package's write_folder. The same bytes in both repositories; both suites hold its sha256. An id is refused when used as <id>.json it would not be one plain file name: it holds / or a backslash, or a control character U+0000 to U+001F, or it is . or .. (checked in that order), whatever the name, since the collision rule can fall back to the full id. A refusal names the type, the id as JSON text and the why given here; no file is written. A written case gives the file's path. Cases written by hand.
